title: Module 1 Synthesis Studio
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting module 1 synthesis studio to the one-page synthesis decision brief (convergence of principles on one screen, a named and resolved conflict, and a recorded rejected alternative), reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Integrate multiple Module 1 principles into one design decision rather than listing them separately.
Name a conflict between two principles and resolve it explicitly for a stated learner.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next.
